finding.text: Deliverable 4 is half built: only `release_say()` writes the `done` line (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:884); nothing writes it when the helper's agent update lands. On the phone, `Recite.agent_update()` (Recite.js:504-517) holds the update while `cue_pending` is set and does not cancel the cue, so a delegated answer that arrives as an agent update leaves the phone beeping every 6 s until the 60 s cap.

`s.thinking_open` is only cleared by `release_say()` (Sessions.js:884). If the seat hands off and ends its turn with `nothing()` (which the brief tells it to do after a silent message to the mastermind, single-voice-assistant.md:36), the flag stays true. Every later hand-off then hits the `!s.thinking_open` guard (Sessions.js:1739) and writes no line, so the beep fails silently from the second hand-off on. Reset it per turn, or write `done` at the turn's result when no say was released.

Deliverable 3's proof is faked. The "answer still arrives" test (Sessions.single.test.mjs, second new check) sets `turn_said = false` by hand and calls `queue_say` itself. It never drives the real path the brief names (an `agent_update` landing, then the seat's next turn, then a say). That path is also where the bug could hide: `turn_said` is only reset in `single_say()` and in `single_cue()`'s `fire()` (Sessions.js:792, :807), not when the seat is woken another way (`feed_smart` :380, :1408).

Deliverable 5 was never run. `node Servex/agents/Sessions.single.test.mjs` fails in the worktree with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, because `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` lives in the main repo's `Servex/node_modules`, not the worktree's. I reproduced this. The Recite test was not run either (it needs a DOM). So nothing in the diff is proven green, including the brief's 900-word cap check: `wc -w` now gives 898.

The old line about this problem is now stale: `public/framework/ux/Dictate/readme.md:89` still says "The thinking sound never plays … proposed 2026-11-03". It should say that hand-off marking and the triple bleep are built, and that the V3 dots are not.

`HANDOFF_TOOL` (Sessions.js:1912) matches any `send_to_agent`. The brief asked only for "send_to_agent to a mastermind", so a message to any agent beeps. Either filter on the target or write down that this was chosen on purpose.

If the hand-off call comes first and the spoken "I've asked the mastermind" comes after it in the same turn, `release_say()` closes the cue at once. The owner then hears silence until the real answer arrives. That fits "no beep after a spoken hand-off", but thinking-sound.md does not mention this order.

Reviewed on branch `worktree/voice-think`, commit b0a7adeaa. `git status` there is not clean: about ten `files.jsonl` files are modified, probably index churn. The brief asked for a clean tree at the end.

The agent_msg close in `Servex/agents/Sessions.js:1738-1745` excludes only `from: "owner"` and `"host"`, so other non-delegate senders also close the cue. One is `"servex-follow"`, which is how a tail-mode seat (`s.tail`) hears the owner's own sentences (`Servex/Follow.js:343`). Others are Servex's `"servex"` spend and read nudges (`Agents.js:2039`, `:2133`) and `"servex-compact-nudge"` / `"servex-landing-check"`. In tail mode, the owner's next sentence silently stops the beep, which the new test claims never happens. Fix: close only for an agent id (for example, not `owner`/`host`/`servex*`), or better, only for the agent that was handed to.

Deliverable 5 is half proven: neither new Recite test (`Recite.test.mjs:533`, `:554`) has ever run, because they need the DOM, and none of `cancel_cue` on `done`, `agent_update()` cancelling, or `resume()` is verified. Before this ask is called done, run them in the Test view (`/framework/core/Test/view/?file=audio/Recite/Recite.test.mjs`) once the branch is merged, or have the mastermind run them headless against the merged site.

The Servex side is not indexed. Neither `Servex/agents/readme.md` nor `Servex/agents/doc/say-tools.md` says that `heard()` now writes `{thinking}` lines, that `release_say` now also writes the `done` line, or that there is a new env var `SERVEX_SESSION_THINKING_OPEN_MS` (`Sessions.js:292`). Only the Recite readme and `ux/Dictate/doc/thinking-sound.md` know. Add one line to `doc/say-tools.md` (where `release_say` is described) and link it from the readme's single-seat line (`Servex/agents/readme.md:111`).

A fresh agent can't continue from this task folder alone. `task.jsonl` holds only the round-1 review line: no minion session id, no commits (`b0a7adeaa`, `4ef7b72d1` on `worktree/voice-think`), no round-2 outcome, and no line saying what is still open (the unrun Recite tests, step 3 V3 dots). Append a status line with those facts.

A turn that ends with `stopped` returns before `s.turn_said = false` (`Sessions.js:1765` vs `:1772`). After an interrupted turn that queued a say, the next turn's hand-off writes no thinking line until a normal `result` resets the flag. This is rare; moving the reset above the `stopped` return would fix it.

"Once per turn" is really "once until closed": the `thinking_open` guard (`Sessions.js:1759`) also blocks a hand-off in a later turn while a cue is open (up to 70 s). This is defensible, since the phone is still beeping, but `thinking-sound.md` should say so in one clause.
The worktree is still not clean: about ten `files.jsonl` files are modified (`git -C C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/voice-think status`). The brief asked for a clean tree; round-1 note 8 was not addressed.

Code comments and `thinking-sound.md`'s "What is built now" are full of history ("review round 2, finding 3", "they were not, the first time"), and that section runs about 600 words. Rule 9 says docs state the structure with no history; trim it to what is built, what is left, and the ordering edge case.

I ran these in the worktree: `Sessions.single.test.mjs` passes 18/18, `say-tools.test.mjs` 12/12, `single-brief.test.mjs` 6/6. The brief is 898 words, under the 900 cap. `Recite.test.mjs` prints "skip in node — needs the DOM".

The hand-off detector never matches a real tool call, so live, no thinking line is ever written and the phone never beeps. `HANDOFF_TOOL` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:1940) is anchored `^spawn_agent$` and `is_handoff` (:1941) compares `event.name === "send_to_agent"`. But `heard()` gets the SDK's `block.name` (Agents.js:1930), and for Servex tools that is `mcp__servex__spawn_agent`, `mcp__servex__send_to_agent` and so on (Agents.js:44 builds those names; Agents.js:1954-1955 already match them with `/spawn_agent$/` for this reason). The tests pass only because they feed bare names (Sessions.single.test.mjs:163, :185 and the rest). Match the suffix (`/(?:^|__)(spawn_agent|ask_mastermind|…)$/`, and the same for send_to_agent), and add one check that uses the prefixed name.

The Recite tests (`done:true` closes the cue; a suspended context is resumed) were never run: `node public/framework/audio/Recite/Recite.test.mjs` prints "skip in node — needs the DOM". thinking-sound.md says so honestly with a ⬜. `core/Test/TestRunner.mjs --browser` or the test view (`/framework/core/Test/view/?file=audio/Recite/Recite.test.mjs`) against a served tree would prove them.

The server writes its `done` line only when the seat releases a say or gets an `agent_msg` from the delegate. If a mastermind writes its answer straight into the session as an agent update, without messaging the seat, the server never closes the `thinking` line. Recite still stops beeping, because `agent_update()` cancels the cue itself (Recite.js:505). But the future V3 "..." row, which reads the same line, would stay up. thinking-sound.md should say this in its ⬜ V3 item.
Two test comments still record review history instead of what they test: "Finding 2:" (Sessions.single.test.mjs:190) and "Review note 6:" (:208). Rule 9 asks for no history.

The worktree is still not clean. About ten `files.jsonl` files show as modified in `git -C C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/voice-think status`. They look like indexer output rather than this task's edits, but the brief asked for a clean tree.

Checked on `worktree/voice-think` at 70f2397e9. I ran `Sessions.single.test.mjs` (19/19 pass), `say-tools.test.mjs` (12/12) and `single-brief.test.mjs` (6/6). The brief is 898 words, under the 900 cap. Round 2's findings were fixed: the turn reset now runs before the `stopped` return, and the per-turn id is in place. The docs are current and linked: say-tools.md, the agents readme, the Recite readme, thinking-sound.md and the Dictate readme line. A fresh agent could continue from this folder plus thinking-sound.md.
